name: 2016-17 Co-Location Reporting
description:
This dataset contains 2016-17 reporting on New York City public schools that share a building with one or more other schools (co-located schools). Each row represents a school, identified by its district-borough-number code (dbn), district, and school name, along with a building identifier and a flag indicating whether the school is part of an organization split across sites. It also notes whether the school is a transfer school.

The data includes total enrollment and enrollment broken out by grade band (pre-K through 5, grades 6-8, and grades 9-12), plus demographic breakdowns by race/ethnicity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White, and multiple race categories not represented), students with disabilities (swd), English language learners (ell), and poverty. Academic indicators cover the number of students tested and proficiency levels on the state ELA and math exams, and graduation outcomes include the total graduation cohort, four-year August graduates, and six-year graduates.
